run_add_person: run the add_person script to add a new person to a protobuf address book file
create_address_book: create a new protobuf AddressBook message and serialize it to a file on disk
parse_protobuf_file: parse an existing protobuf address book file using ParseFromString and read its contents
add_person_entry: add a new person entry with id, name, email, and phone numbers to an address book
serialize_address_book: serialize a protobuf AddressBook message to a binary string and write it to a file
